visual_system_craft.critique: The design suffers from severe visual fragmentation and inconsistent component grammar. The chess pieces are the primary failure: they are rendered as low-fidelity, hand-drawn style icons with thick, uneven strokes and heavy drop shadows that clash with the flat, modern UI aesthetic of the side panel. The piece glyphs lack a unified geometric baseline, appearing 'wobbly' and unprofessional. The coordinate labels (a-h, 1-8) are visually weak, using a tiny sans-serif font that lacks legibility and alignment precision. Ensure all buttons share the same border-radius and padding rhythm.
